CustomField.description: How much of each turn is stored as AI Execution Steps. Off: no steps for the turn (and so no masking evidence). Summary: one step per provider call and data source with names, counts and timings, and no payload. Full: as Summary, plus the request and response JSON and the sent preview on the last provider call of every turn. A Workflow Action a user runs is always recorded. Blank or any other value means Summary. Text, because a custom setting cannot hold a picklist.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Off, Summary or Full. Only Full stores the request and response JSON, for every turn: it uses the most storage. Default Summary.
CustomField.label: Step Capture Mode
